title: Task commands answer in under half a second and closed tasks archive (S17)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S17 (Sector 5 — Tasks (ADR 0018)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0018 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector.
Outcome: single-task verbs read one file; `krn task archive` moves tasks closed over 14 days to `tasks/archive/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl`; `Ticket:` checks read both
Files: see ADR 0018 Consequences.
Proof: `ls tasks/*.json | wc -l: < 80` and `node --test test/task/archive-ticket.test.ts: pass`
Predicted: metric task-show-ms < 450
After: S12
